name: Akili Interactive (EndeavorRx, EndeavorOTC)

ownership_change.structure: Akili operates as wholly owned subsidiary of Virtual Therapeutics (private)

short_description: First FDA-cleared video game-based digital therapeutic for ADHD. EndeavorRx (prescription, ages 8-17) and EndeavorOTC (non-prescription, adults) deliver attention treatment through engaging gameplay.
long_description: Akili Interactive pioneered video game-based digital therapeutics with EndeavorRx, which became the first FDA-cleared video game treatment in June 2020. Originally approved for children ages 8-12 with inattentive or combined-type ADHD, FDA expanded the label in 2024 to include adolescents 13-17, more than doubling the eligible patient population. In June 2024, Akili received FDA clearance for EndeavorOTC, the first FDA-authorized over-the-counter digital treatment for adults with ADHD. The treatments use the same proprietary SSME (Selective Stimulus Management Engine) technology to target attention through adaptive, engaging gameplay. While Akili found the prescription model challenging for building a sustainable business, the OTC expansion addresses the growing adult ADHD market. Akili merged with Virtual Therapeutics in 2024, becoming a private company subsidiary.

faqs.q: Is EndeavorRx FDA approved for ADHD?
faqs.a: Yes, EndeavorRx received FDA De Novo clearance in June 2020, becoming the first video game cleared by FDA as a treatment. It's indicated for children ages 8-17 with inattentive or combined-type ADHD.
EndeavorRx costs $99 for a 30-day prescription. It's FSA/HSA eligible, and insurance coverage was expected for ~60% of covered lives by end of 2024.

faqs.q: What is EndeavorOTC and how is it different from EndeavorRx?
faqs.a: EndeavorOTC is an over-the-counter version for adults (18+) that doesn't require a prescription. It uses the same technology and costs $69.99/3 months, $99.99/6 months, or $129.99/year.

EndeavorRx uses proprietary SSME (Selective Stimulus Management Engine) technology to target and activate neural systems controlling attention through adaptive, engaging video gameplay. Treatment protocol is 25 minutes/day, 5 days/week for 1 month.
